cases_without_input_or_successful_runs: retained eligible workflow failures; no invented poses or score
comparison_scope: Within one fixed ligand and unchanged torsion normalization only. Shared-reference absolute energies cannot compare molecular affinities across ligands.
input_adapter: Restore exact source monosaccharide residue IDs and canonical names from frozen atom map, keeping pose coordinates/torsion tree. Native atom-coordinate references are never scorer input.
pool: Every retained pose from all originally scheduled seeds and available boxes in the frozen source experiment, without truth-based filtering; per-seed box-budget1 and5 subsets fixed by original class ranks
pose_endpoints: Identical frozen qualified full/core atom masks and global/local receptor-frame metrics as original Vina pool; no independent ligand fitting
primary_question: Does CHI change ranking of available qualified poses? Missing near-native retained poses do not prove internal sampling failure.
purpose: Fixed-retained-pose ranking control: original Vina-Carb base and carbohydrate CHI score on exactly the same Vina1.2.7 candidates; no new sampling or coordinate optimization
rank_ties: score, original candidate class rank, original within-box model rank
unsupported_chemistry: Unrecognized glycosidic donor or missing phi/psi links is an explicit unsupported scoring failure, not a silent zero-CHI success.
